purpose: Compact reviewer-facing summary of the robustness evaluation suite.

rows.question: How quickly do fidelity and agreement degrade under replay noise?
rows.coverage: MC / CP / LL; CBS, RV, DT
rows.headline: LunarLander mean BRA drop ranges 0.323-0.590; in MountainCar, RV and DT stay above 90% BRA through eps=0.08.

rows.question: Are aggregate scores hiding minority-action failure?
rows.headline: MountainCar worst-R passes 0.70 at 5% support; LunarLander tops out at 0.341 even at 12%.

rows.question: Do the stability patterns depend on the RL algorithm family?
rows.headline: CBS BRA changes only +0.006 on CartPole and +0.096 on LunarLander under PPO vs DQN.

rows.question: Are the conclusions stable to rho/lambda matching choices?
rows.headline: Matching choices matter: CartPole BRA spans 0.448-0.808; LunarLander mean F1 spans 0.412-0.523.

rows.question: Do the paper-level claims survive formal uncertainty checks?
rows.what_varies: Paired bootstrap confidence intervals and p-values
rows.headline: All 6/6 core claims are supported and significant in all 3 environments.

rows.question: Do the Experiment B repairs hold up statistically?
rows.what_varies: DCM, MTC, and SSC repair stages
rows.headline: DCM->MTC is significant in 3/3 envs; DCM->SSC is significant in 3/3 envs; MTC->SSC is significant in 2/3.
